controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:40:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:40:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND (process.name == "sshd" OR message LIKE "*sshd*" OR message LIKE "*Accepted*" OR message LIKE "*Failed password*" OR message LIKE "*pam_unix*" OR message LIKE "*session*")
| STATS event_count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY event_type = CASE(message LIKE "*Accepted*", "Accepted",
                             message LIKE "*Failed password*", "Failed",
                             message LIKE "*pam_unix*", "pam_unix",
                             message LIKE "*session*", "session",
                             "other")
| SORT event_count DESC
